text: 证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。坚决打击和遏制违法违规行为。落实中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅《关于依法从严打击证券违法活动的意见》，严防严打房地产证券发行人欺诈发行、信息披露造假、挪用募集资金等违法违规行为，加大对系统性、团伙性造假的惩戒力度，强化对第三方配合造假以及保荐人、承销机构、会计师事务所等中介机构证券违法违规行为的打击力度，对各类财务造假行为“零容忍”。对于情节恶劣、市场影响重大、引致重大风险的违法案件，依法从严处罚。
text_en: The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. It will resolutely crack down on and curb illegal and non-compliant activities. In implementing the Opinions on Strictly Cracking Down on Securities Illegal Activities in accordance with the Law issued by the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, it will strictly prevent and crack down on fraudulent issuance, information disclosure fraud, and misappropriation of raised funds by real estate securities issuers, intensify penalties for systematic and gang-style fraud, strengthen efforts to combat third-party complicity in fraud and securities violations by sponsor institutions, underwriting institutions, accounting firms, and other intermediaries, and maintain zero tolerance for all forms of financial fraud. For illegal cases with egregious circumstances, significant market impact, or major risks, penalties will be imposed strictly in accordance with the law.
